text:
Alyssa: FYI received a call from HW partner — one outbound container is held in Rotterdam customs, estimated 6–10 day delay. Contains 40% of our EU Dedicated GPU reservation for next-week slots.
Mateo: Oof. Do we have visibility on which SKUs are in that container?
Alyssa: Partner says: mix of A100-80G and some replacement 80GB ampere variants. They sent PO# 89012-RTM.
Sophia: This will impact autoscale/inventory mapping on the EU pools. Need to flag routing fallback now.
Liam: Also heads-up, marketplace promo is scheduled Mon. If capacity drops we risk over-commit on reserved SKUs for Marketplace customers.
Alyssa: Agreed. Can we temporarily pause the marketplace promo or throttle quota to avoid launching customers into a queue? @Liam
Liam: I can reduce burst capacity and set per-account caps, but need confirmation from legal for customer-facing messaging. @Devon
Devon: Fine to throttle, but any customer-facing delay needs wording that avoids implying a service outage. Suggest: "supply cadence update" + credit offer.
Mateo: Partner offered to split the shipment: release unaffected racks we can airfreight immediately but that requires extra cost. They asked if Redwood can cover expedited freight for 8 racks to preserve the EU SLA.
Sophia: If we airfreight those racks in, we can keep canary capacity for the canary traffic. But we need a fast PO amendment and billing ok.
Alyssa: Can partnerships cover the negotiation? I'll ping partner contacts.
Mateo: I can draft amendment + cost delta. Estimated additional freight = $26k.
Liam: If we approve airfreight, I can keep the marketplace promo live but reduce new customer slot allocation by 30% until inventory reconciles.
Devon: Approve promo throttle approach. Keep messaging non-technical and offer a one-time credit to affected signups.
Alyssa: @VendorOpsBot can you pull the reservation mapping for EU pools and list affected customer commit windows?
VendorOpsBot: Inventory query started for PO 89012-RTM. Returning reservations: 12 dedicated customers, 3 marketplace subscriptions in next 7 days.
Sophia: Thanks. Action items: 1) Mateo to approve PO amendment (ETA 2h), 2) Alyssa to confirm partner split & airfreight option (ETA 1h), 3) Liam to adjust promo caps and customer messaging (ETA 3h), 4) Devon to draft wording (ETA 2h).
Mateo: I'm on PO now. If we go ahead, finance needs a pre-approval code.
Alyssa: I'll request pre-approval and post updates here.
Liam: If airfreight doesn't go through, we should prepare auto-fallback to NA capacity for lower-tier customers and notify enterprise customers.
Sophia: I'll add a temporary routing rule: EU -> fallthrough NA-1 for non-SLA traffic. Patching config now.
Alyssa: Thanks all. I'll coordinate with partner and loop back with a final decision before EOD. :white_check_mark:
Mateo: Thx.
Devon: Keep ticket of messaging drafts for audit.
VendorOpsBot: Inventory query complete. Detailed CSV attached to ticket #PR-4778.
Alyssa: Closing loop — will post final status here once partner confirms split.
